g.text: Cue-on deflection and cue-free retention are different readouts
The same 80 stationary-cue histories: open markers at withdrawal; filled markers after 13,000 cue-free units.
Thin vertical lines pair the same duration. Dotted lines mark exact prescribed cue normals; connecting curves guide the eye between tested points.
Displayed angle is masked at R < 0.1. Square outline: retained full-field tail gate failed. Four compact reuses have no full-field tail qualification.
All 35 initial overlaps are retained. Native widths, peaks and clocks remain model-specific; this activity-vector readout does not specify cell motion.
